label: T&W TWC GPON657 GPON SFP ONU
description: GPON ONU built into an SFP module (Realtek RTL9601CI, Linux Luna SDK) with a 2.5G HSGMII host interface to the router's SFP/SFP+ cage; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/APC, no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI or SSH.
